subject.title: fix(ui): teardown MCP Apps before unmount

question: Should the Control UI accept a bounded up-to-250-ms render-commit delay to guarantee connected MCP App teardown across route, pane, and virtualized-view replacement?
rationale: The patch intentionally trades immediate UI commit timing for lifecycle cleanup, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit human judgment on that product/runtime trade-off.

options.title: Approve after lifecycle-owner confirmation
options.body: Confirm the gate preserves router, split-pane, and virtualizer invariants under teardown timeout and rapid replacement, then merge the focused lifecycle fix.

options.title: Narrow the owner coverage
options.body: Limit the gate to the render owners proven to detach live MCP App frames if broad chat rendering delays are not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve after lifecycle-owner confirmation
recommendation.body: Confirm the gate preserves router, split-pane, and virtualizer invariants under teardown timeout and rapid replacement, then merge the focused lifecycle fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They have prior merged MCP Apps implementation history and authored the proposed lifecycle integration.
